boundary_condition: Applies only to hotel room-type configuration; it does not set the destination, travel dates, number of rooms, or party size.
condition: When booking a hotel stay and a room type or room configuration must be selected, with no explicit conflicting room-type requirement provided.
default_action: Request or select a double room.
exception_condition: If the traveler explicitly requests a different room type or the party needs a configuration a double room cannot satisfy, use that specified configuration instead.
name: Defaults to a double room for hotel room type
rationale: The three independent hotel conversations all specify a double room as the requested room type. This supports a controlled synthetic-user default for hotel room configuration without treating the speakers as one real longitudinal user.

source_evidence.contribution: The user says, "I want like the double room," grounding double room as the hotel room-type preference.
The user says, "I'd like to have a double room," again supporting double room as the selected room configuration.
The user answers, "Double room," directly specifying the hotel room type.

source_examples.user_utterance: No, just all just one adult, but I want like the double room.
And, I'd like to have a double room.
